author: everestmcarthur
install_msg:
Thanks for installing **NexusCore v2.0.0** — The ultimate all-in-one server management cog!

**Modules (10):** Tickets, Applications, Suggestions, Reaction Roles, Giveaways, Server Logging, Moderation, Economy, Embed Builder, Dashboard Integration.

**Quick Start:**
• `[p]nexus` — Module overview & version
• `[p]ticket setup #category #logs` — Set up tickets
• `[p]apply setup #review` — Set up applications
• `[p]suggest setup #suggestions` — Set up suggestions
• `[p]roles create #channel button Title` — Create a role panel
• `[p]gw start #channel 1d 1 Prize` — Start a giveaway
• `[p]serverlog enable #logs` — Enable logging (30+ events)
• `[p]nmod setup #modlog` — Set up moderation
• `[p]eco balance` — Check your balance
• `[p]eb create` — Interactive embed builder

100+ commands. Full help: `[p]help NexusCore`
name: NexusCore
short: The ultimate all-in-one: Tickets, Applications, Suggestions, Reaction Roles, Giveaways, Logging, Moderation, Economy, Embed Builder & Dashboard. 100+ commands.
description: NexusCore v2.0.0 combines ten powerful server management systems into one professional cog. NEW IN V2: Embed Builder (webhook-based, Sapphire-style, templates, scheduling, variables), Dashboard Integration (web config for all modules), expanded logging (30+ event types, emoji/thread/sticker/permission/webhook/scheduled events, retention, search), expanded moderation (quarantine, reputation, warning decay, staff leaderboard, punishment templates, cross-server ban sync, appeal system), expanded economy (roulette, dice, lottery, stock market, fishing, mining, crafting, achievements, income roles, auction house, gambling stats), expanded tickets (auto-close, tags, HTML transcripts, staff tracking, priority, feedback, reopen, archive), expanded applications (staff voting, bulk actions, webhook notifications, templates, conditional questions), expanded suggestions (edit, merge duplicates, 10 statuses, tag system, auto-approve/deny thresholds), expanded reaction roles (verification panels, exclusive groups, sticky/temp roles, clone, stats), expanded giveaways (drop mode, bonus entries, templates, custom embeds, DM notifications). ORIGINAL: TICKETS: Panel-based creation with button/select/modal flows, categories with custom questions, staff claim system, priority levels (low/medium/high/urgent), HTML transcript export, auto-close, feedback ratings, DM notifications, blacklisting, per-user limits. APPLICATIONS: Multi-type forms with modal-based questions (supports 10+ questions via multi-page modals), review system with accept/deny/interview buttons, auto-role on accept, staff notes, auto-thread for discussion, cooldowns, account/server age requirements, DM results. SUGGESTIONS: Voting with buttons or reactions, 8 status types (pending/approved/denied/considered/implemented/in_progress/duplicate/invalid), anonymous mode, auto-thread discussion, staff responses, category support, top suggestions leaderboard, status-specific channels. REACTION ROLES: Three modes (button/select/reaction), exclusive groups, role requirements, blacklisted roles, sticky roles, temporary roles, max picks per panel, DM confirmation, persistent across restarts. GIVEAWAYS: Button-entry with requirements (role/account age/server age), bonus entries per role, multiple winners, reroll, drop giveaways (first N to click), recurring giveaways, DM notifications, blacklisting. LOGGING: 20+ event types (messages, members, roles, channels, voice, invites, emoji), per-event channel routing, message content cache for deleted messages, invite tracking, ignore filters (channels/roles/users/bots), bulk delete with file export. MODERATION: Case system with numbered entries, warn system with auto-escalation (configurable thresholds to mute/tempban/ban), timeout/kick/ban/softban/tempban, staff notes, user history, purge, channel/server lockdown, anti-raid (join flood detection), anti-nuke (mass delete protection), auto-mod (anti-spam/caps/invites/links/mentions/newlines), appeal system with modals. ECONOMY: Wallet + bank with deposit/withdraw, daily/weekly rewards with streak bonuses, work/crime with custom messages, rob other users, coinflip/slots/blackjack gambling with interactive views, shop system (items + role items), inventory, heist mini-game (multiplayer), pet system (6 types, leveling, feeding, daily earnings), leaderboard, pay/transfer with tax, admin controls, configurable currency name/emoji.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord user IDs, guild IDs, and channel IDs for its functionality. Per-user data includes: ticket history, application submissions, suggestion authorship, moderation cases/warnings/notes, economy balances/inventories/pets/transactions, giveaway entries, and reaction role state.
